summary: @ppa-web-components/ppa-builder beacons installer host metadata to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint at install and import
details: The package ships a `postinstall` script that executes `beacon.cjs`, which POSTs JSON containing `os.hostname()`, `__dirname`, `process.cwd()`, and `process.version` to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint `http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc` over plain HTTP. The main entry `index.js` also invokes the same beacon on `require`, so both `npm install` and any downstream `require()` trigger the exfiltration. The package otherwise provides no functionality: it describes itself as a 'Compatibility shim' and `module.exports` is a `Proxy` that returns a no-op function for every property access. Shape, scoped name, and sole-purpose beaconing are consistent with a dependency-confusion probe or reconnaissance payload rather than a working library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
